name: Admin consent (Microsoft Entra ID)
short_description: Admin consent is the Microsoft Entra ID process in which an administrator grants an application permissions on behalf of the whole organization. It is required for application permissions and for high-impact delegated permissions that regular users cannot consent to themselves.
